## Setup required

This workflow needs two credentials before it will run:

**1. Slack Incoming Webhook URL** (used in "Send updates to Slack")
- Go to https://api.slack.com/apps -> your app (or create one) -> **Incoming Webhooks**
- Turn on Incoming Webhooks, click **Add New Webhook to Workspace**, pick the channel
- Copy the generated URL (`https://hooks.slack.com/services/...`) and paste it into the node's `url` field, replacing the placeholder

**2. Buffer API bearer token** (used in "HTTP Request", "Get channels", "Get draft posts")
- Go to https://buffer.com/developers/apps, create/select an app
- Generate an **Access Token**
- In n8n, create a new credential of type **Bearer Auth** (or **HTTP Bearer Auth**) with that token, then select it in each of the three Buffer HTTP Request nodes
